images.prompt: Premium editorial illustration, high-end tech magazine style: a surgical operating theater where two focused engineers in surgical attire perform delicate work on a living network — a glowing lattice of cables and nodes on the table, its light pulses still flowing steadily through every strand mid-operation; in the corner, a discarded sledgehammer leans against the wall, rejected. Precision over demolition; the patient never stops running. Deep dark navy (#161a45) dominant palette, soft cream (#F4EFE3) highlights, thin red (#eb2027) accent on a single suture thread only — no green, no purple, no rainbow palettes. No readable text, letters, or numbers anywhere. Cinematic moody lighting, minimalist composition.
